faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IPGME&R-SSKM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in IPGME&R-SSKM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 9 vacancies: 3 House Staff - TCU, 2 House Staff - Medicine (KPH), 1 House Staff - Anaesthesiology, 1 House Staff - Medicine (SNPH), 1 House Staff - Pulmonary Medicine (SNPH), 1 House Staff - Neuro Medicine.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for IPGME&R-SSKM Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Offline submission directly at receiving section) and send it to Receiving Section of MSVP Office, SSKM Hospital, Kol-20, by submission at the receiving section of msvp office, to reach by 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Stipendiary House Staff ship; stipend amount not printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q5. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Former students of IPGME&R who passed out not earlier than 2022 and have completed the 12-month compulsory rotating internship (MBBS certificate, mark sheets and Medical Council registration to be enclosed). The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q6. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must not be engaged in any Government, Private or other sector or establishment; self-declaration required. Preference order: fresh candidates who completed internship in 2026 (waitlisted), then house job under 6 months, then 6 months to under 1 year, then others.

faq.question: Q7. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Students passed out earlier than 2022. Students of any other institutions. Those attached in any kind of Government Service at present.

faq.question: Q8. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Tenure fixed department-wise, ending 17.05.27 or 31.05.27 as per the seat matrix.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: IPGME&R-SSKM Hospital, Kolkata and its annexes (KPH, SNPH).

faq.question: Q10. Which documents are needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: MBBS Certificate; Mark sheets of all academic years related to MBBS; Provisional/Permanent Medical council Registration Certificate; Internship completion certificate; Permanent residential address & contact number; Photo ID proof.
